boundary: One start/end subtraction: before optional setup and fixture preparation through 4320 fixed physics ticks, final edit acknowledgement, native phase closure, writer drain, terrain/preparation retirement, optional summary serialization/flush/close and complete per-trial report serialization/flush/close. Nested spans are evidence, not additive costs.

protocol.shipping_condition: null and positive controls both pass; otherwise stop without another calibration family
protocol.positive_dose: Native SHA256 over fixed 4096-byte Z bytes, per real tick. Request ceil(positive A0 complete cycle midpoint/(50*4320)), fixed before B1/B2. Retain ordered process/thread observations, wall brackets, updates and digests. Sum 4320 thread-cycle demand intervals; actual/reference bounds must lie above 1% and at/below 3%, overlap measured positive range whose lower bound is at/above 1%. No sleep, yield, dose adjustment or retry.
protocol.stop_rule: On overlap, negative attribution, unresolved matching-section drift, invalid controls or missing work/I/O/operation evidence: inconclusive; stop and request an explicit measurement/repetition/threshold policy decision. No automatic reruns or profile matrix.
protocol.early_stop: At any failed work/counter/I/O/operation guard retain prefix and failed/partial trial, inconclusive and stop. Stop after unresolved null (5 trials), positive (9) or shipping (13).
